parameters.content:
## Callback scheduler
Every 5 min (inside calling hours) picks due rows from the **Callbacks** sheet (handler = ai, status = pending), re-checks the DNC sheet, then places the call through Vapi. Retries for no-answer/voicemail, 'call me later' requests and out-of-hours leads all land here.

parameters.url: ={{ 'https://sheets.googleapis.com/v4/spreadsheets/' + $('Prep Call Result').item.json.cfg.google.spreadsheet_id + '/values/' + encodeURIComponent($('Prep Call Result').item.json.cfg.google.tabs.callbacks + '!J' + $('Prep Call Result').item.json.row + ':K' + $('Prep Call Result').item.json.row) + '?valueInputOption=RAW' }}
parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify(({ values: [[$('Prep Call Result').item.json.finalStatus, $('Prep Call Result').item.json.finalNote]] })) }}
